subject: maths
card: Length, mass and capacity: reading rulers and scales, and converting mm, cm, m, km, g, kg, ml and litres.
title: Measurement
seo_title: Measurement practice for KS2: length, mass, capacity and converting units
description: Free KS2 measurement practice: read rulers and measuring jugs, and convert between mm, cm, m and km, grams and kilograms, millilitres and litres. Word problems with pictures and hints for ages 9 to 11.
intro: How long, how heavy, how much does it hold? Learn the metric units, read rulers and scales, and change from one unit to another.

units.title: Length: mm, cm, m and km
units.blurb: Measure lengths and change between units.

learn.p: 10 millimetres (mm) = 1 centimetre (cm). 100 cm = 1 metre (m). 1000 m = 1 kilometre (km).
Start at 0, not at the end of the ruler. The small marks are millimetres. This arrow is at 4 cm and 5 mm, which is 4.5 cm or 45 mm.
To a smaller unit, multiply: 3 m = 300 cm. To a bigger unit, divide: 2500 m = 2.5 km.

questions.q: Where is the arrow? Give your answer in cm.
questions.hint: Read the number under the arrow.
questions.explain: The arrow is at the big mark labelled 6, so it's 6 cm.

questions.q: Where is the arrow? Give your answer in mm.
questions.hint: Each cm is 10 mm. Count the small marks after 3.
questions.explain: The arrow is 7 small marks after 3 cm: 3 cm 7 mm = 30 mm + 7 mm = 37 mm.

questions.q: 4 m = ? cm
5 cm = ? mm
Which is the best estimate for the length of a pencil?
questions.hint: A ruler is usually 30 cm long.
questions.explain: A pencil is about half a ruler long: about 15 cm. 15 mm is shorter than your thumbnail is wide.

units.title: Mass: grams and kilograms
units.blurb: How heavy things are, and changing g to kg.

learn.p: 1000 grams (g) = 1 kilogram (kg). A paper clip is about 1 g. A bag of sugar is often 1 kg.
kg to g: multiply by 1000. 2 kg = 2000 g. g to kg: divide by 1000. 500 g = 0.5 kg, which is half a kilogram.
3 kg 250 g is 3000 g + 250 g = 3250 g. As kilograms, that's 3.25 kg.

questions.q: 3 kg = ? g
1 kg 400 g = ? g
questions.hint: Change the kg to g, then add.

questions.q: How many grams are in half a kilogram?
questions.explain: 1 kg = 1000 g, and half of 1000 is 500 g.

questions.q: Which is the best estimate for the mass of an apple?
questions.hint: A bag of sugar is 1 kg. Is an apple lighter or heavier?
questions.explain: An apple is much lighter than a bag of sugar: about 150 g.

questions.q: A cake needs 250 g of flour. How many grams do you need for 4 cakes?

units.title: Capacity: ml and litres
units.blurb: How much a container holds, and reading a jug.

learn.p: 1000 millilitres (ml) = 1 litre (l). A teaspoon holds about 5 ml. A big bottle of water often holds 2 litres.
Look at the marks and work out what each step is worth. Here the marks go up in 100s, and the water is at 600 ml.
Litres to ml: multiply by 1000. 1.5 l = 1500 ml. ml to litres: divide by 1000. 250 ml = 0.25 l.

questions.q: How much water is in the jug?
questions.explain: The water is level with the 300 mark, so there is 300 ml.

questions.q: How much water is in the jug?
questions.hint: It's halfway between two marks. What is halfway between 700 and 800?
questions.explain: The water is halfway between 700 and 800, so there is 750 ml.

questions.q: 2 litres = ? ml
3500 ml = ? litres
A jug has 1 litre of juice. You fill 4 cups with 200 ml each. How much juice is left?
questions.explain: 1 litre = 1000 ml. 4 × 200 = 800 ml is poured, so 1000 − 800 = 200 ml is left.

questions.q: Which is the best estimate for how much a mug holds?
questions.hint: A teaspoon is about 5 ml. A big water bottle is about 2 litres.
questions.explain: A mug holds about 300 ml: much more than a teaspoon, much less than a big bottle.

units.title: Measurement problems
units.blurb: Use the same units, then work it out.

learn.p: You can't add 2 m and 30 cm as 2 + 30. Change one first: 2 m = 200 cm, so 200 cm + 30 cm = 230 cm, or 2.3 m.
Find what the question wants, and in which unit. Then underline the numbers you need.
If a door comes out at 20 m tall, something went wrong! Doors are about 2 m tall.

questions.q: A ribbon is 2 m long. You cut off 35 cm. How many cm are left?
A bag has 1.2 kg of rice. Another has 800 g. How many grams altogether?
questions.explain: 1200 g + 800 g = 2000 g, which is 2 kg.

questions.q: Mia walks 750 m to school and 750 m home, every day for 5 days. How many km is that?
questions.hint: One day is 1500 m. Then times by 5, and change to km.

questions.q: A 2 litre bottle of squash is shared equally between 8 glasses. How many ml go in each glass?
Which is longest?
questions.explain: 1.2 m = 120 cm, 115 cm, 1050 mm = 105 cm, 0.9 m = 90 cm. So 1.2 m is the longest.

questions.q: A parcel weighs 3 kg. Each book inside weighs 500 g, and the box weighs nothing. How many books are in it?
